dialogues.jp: 「ふぅ……いい天気だな」
dialogues.en: "Hoo... good weather."
dialogues.text: "Hoo... good weather."

dialogues.jp:
空を仰ぎ見て、雲のない青い空とその｛はる／遥｝か手前
にある桜の花を眺める。
dialogues.en:
I stared up at the sky, cloudless and blue, partially hidden
by bundles of sakura petals.
dialogues.text:
I stared up at the sky, cloudless and blue, partially hidden
by bundles of sakura petals.

dialogues.jp:
公園では、散歩をしたりベンチで読書をしたり、
キャッチボールをしたりお弁当を食べたりして、
皆が午後のひとときを過ごしている。
dialogues.en:
There were people talking walks, reading at benches, playing
catch, eating lunchboxes, and other activities to pass the
afternoon.
dialogues.text:
There were people talking walks, reading at benches, playing
catch, eating lunchboxes, and other activities to pass the
afternoon.

dialogues.jp: 「俺はどうするかな」
dialogues.en: "I wonder what I should do."
dialogues.text: "I wonder what I should do."

dialogues.jp:
ざっ、と辺りを見渡して、まぁ、いつものコー
スで行くことにした。
dialogues.en:
Looking around the park, I chose the one I did the most
before.
dialogues.text:
Looking around the park, I chose the one I did the most
before.

dialogues.jp: 芝生の上に寝転がり、空を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
I found a nice grassy field to lie on, and looked up at the
sky.
dialogues.text:
I found a nice grassy field to lie on, and looked up at the
sky.

dialogues.jp:
太陽がぽかぽかと光を注いでいて、気持ちいい。
目を｛つむ／瞑｝ると、まるで太陽に抱かれているみたい
だ。
dialogues.en:
The sun's rays shining down felt good. I slowly closed my
eyes, preventing the sun from penetrating them.
dialogues.text:
The sun's rays shining down felt good. I slowly closed my
eyes, preventing the sun from penetrating them.

dialogues.jp: 「おやすみなさい」
dialogues.en: "Good night."
dialogues.text: "Good night."

dialogues.jp: 「やばっ！？」
dialogues.en: "Oh crap!?"
dialogues.text: "Oh crap!?"

dialogues.jp: いつの間にか、本気で寝てしまったのか。
dialogues.en: I had taken a really long nap.
dialogues.text: I had taken a really long nap.

dialogues.jp: 「早く帰らないと！」
dialogues.en: "If I don't rush back...!"
dialogues.text: "If I don't rush back...!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢にどやされる。
dialogues.en: I'd be at the mercy of Nemu.
dialogues.text: I'd be at the mercy of Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
よっ――と飛び起き、服についた草を払い落と
して、駆け出す。
dialogues.en:
I quickly jumped to my feet, brushed off the grass on my
clothes, and dashed away.
dialogues.text:
I quickly jumped to my feet, brushed off the grass on my
clothes, and dashed away.

dialogues.jp:
外灯の消えたドアの前で家の鍵を取り出し、鍵
穴に差し込む。
dialogues.en:
The lights at the door were switched off. I took out my key
and inserted it into the keyhole.
dialogues.text:
The lights at the door were switched off. I took out my key
and inserted it into the keyhole.

dialogues.jp: カチャリ――
dialogues.en: --*turn*
dialogues.text: --*turn*

dialogues.jp: （音夢のやつ怒ってるかな……）
dialogues.en: "(Nemu's going to be pissed...)"
dialogues.text: "(Nemu's going to be pissed...)"

dialogues.jp: 言い訳を考えつつ、ドアのノブを回す。
dialogues.en: Thinking while acting, I turned the doorknob.
dialogues.text: Thinking while acting, I turned the doorknob.

dialogues.jp: ガンッ――
dialogues.en: --*bang*
dialogues.text: --*bang*

dialogues.jp: 「ガン？」
dialogues.en: "Bang?"
dialogues.text: "Bang?"

dialogues.jp:
ドアは少し開いたところで、それ以上引けなく
なる。
dialogues.en: The door opened slightly, but wouldn't go any further.
dialogues.text: The door opened slightly, but wouldn't go any further.

dialogues.jp: 見ると、ドアにチェーンが繋がっていた。
dialogues.en: Has the door has been chain-latched...?
dialogues.text: Has the door has been chain-latched...?

dialogues.jp: 「うっそ、マジ！？」
dialogues.en: "No way, seriously!?"
dialogues.text: "No way, seriously!?"

dialogues.jp: 「おい、音夢ッ！　いないのか、おいっ！」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Nemuu! Are you there, oy!"
dialogues.text: "Oy, Nemuu! Are you there, oy!"

dialogues.jp: ドアの隙間から、家の中に向かって声をかける。
dialogues.en:
I placed my mouth at the slight gap of the door, and shouted
into the house.
dialogues.text:
I placed my mouth at the slight gap of the door, and shouted
into the house.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あら、どちら様ですかぁ？」
dialogues.en: "My, who is it?"
dialogues.text: "My, who is it?"

dialogues.jp: 隙間から、ひょいっと顔が覗いた。
dialogues.en: A face came peeping out from the gap.
dialogues.text: A face came peeping out from the gap.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、俺だけど……」
dialogues.en: "I, it's me..."
dialogues.text: "I, it's me..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、兄さんでしたか。どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, nii-san. What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, nii-san. What's wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あの、ドアがこれ以上開かないんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Uhm, the door won't open any further than this."
dialogues.text: "Uhm, the door won't open any further than this."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃあ、チェーンがかかってますから」
dialogues.en: "That's because I put the chain latch on it."
dialogues.text: "That's because I put the chain latch on it."

dialogues.jp: 当然のことのように、音夢が言う。
dialogues.en: Nemu said that matter-of-factly.
dialogues.text: Nemu said that matter-of-factly.

dialogues.jp: いや、そうなんだけど。
dialogues.en: No, that's not what I meant...
dialogues.text: No, that's not what I meant...

dialogues.jp:
「あの……音夢さん。これ、はずしてもらえな
　いでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Uhmm... Nemu-san. Could you remove the chain latch?"
dialogues.text: "Uhmm... Nemu-san. Could you remove the chain latch?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ダメです」
dialogues.en: "I can not."
dialogues.text: "I can not."

dialogues.jp: きっぱりあっさり、拒否される。
dialogues.en: Her denial was quick and clear.
dialogues.text: Her denial was quick and clear.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いま何時だと思ってるの！？　しばらく、そ
　こで頭を冷やしてなさいッ！」
dialogues.en:
"Just what time do yoiu think it is!? You can sit there and
let your head freeze for awhile!"
dialogues.text:
"Just what time do yoiu think it is!? You can sit there and
let your head freeze for awhile!"

dialogues.jp:
ぴしゃりと言い放ち、俺に背を向け居間に戻っ
てしまう。
dialogues.en: With awfully harsh words, she went back to the living room.
dialogues.text: With awfully harsh words, she went back to the living room.

dialogues.jp: ――ぐすん。
dialogues.en: --Sniff.
dialogues.text: --Sniff.

dialogues.jp: 俺は家のドアを閉め、その前に座り込んだ。
dialogues.en:
I closed the door to the house, and sat on the steps in
front of it.
dialogues.text:
I closed the door to the house, and sat on the steps in
front of it.

dialogues.jp: あぁ――今夜は月が綺麗だ。
dialogues.en: Ahh--the moon is beautiful tonight.
dialogues.text: Ahh--the moon is beautiful tonight.

dialogues.jp: ◆門限破り◆
dialogues.en: ◆Past Curfew◆
dialogues.text: ◆Past Curfew◆

dialogues.jp:
いい天気。ぽかぽかといい陽気。そんな訳で、
つい眠くなってしまった。
dialogues.en:
The weather was good, and the sun was just strong enough.
Because of that, I ended up falling asleep.
dialogues.text:
The weather was good, and the sun was just strong enough.
Because of that, I ended up falling asleep.

dialogues.jp: 目が覚めると、夜になっていた。
dialogues.en: By the time I woke up, it was night.
dialogues.text: By the time I woke up, it was night.

dialogues.jp:
ドアにチェーンが掛かっていて、家に入れない。
音夢から締め出しを食らってしまったのだ……。
dialogues.en:
The door to my home was chain-latched, so I couldn't go in.
I've been shut out by Nemu...
dialogues.text:
The door to my home was chain-latched, so I couldn't go in.
I've been shut out by Nemu...
